mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that reduces recession risk while maintaining growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above the 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS is above 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a strengthening supply chain and economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recovery when INDPRO rebounds above 6-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
